claims: Team USA defeated the Dominican Republic 2-1.
The game was a 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal.
The game was at loanDepot park in Miami.
Paul Skenes pitched 4 1/3 innings for the USA.
Junior Caminero hit a solo homer in the second inning.
Gunnar Henderson and Roman Anthony hit back-to-back solo homers in the fourth inning to break a 1-1 tie.
The game ended on a called strike three.
Julio Rodriguez robbed Aaron Judge of a home run.
The USA advanced to the 2026 World Baseball Classic final to play against Venezuela or Italy.
